info.title: ATK API
info.description: The Agentic Tool Kit API: registry reads, publish, checkout and web sign-in for the ATK CLI and web app. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <GitHub token>`; the caller must be an active member of the EmergentSoftware GitHub organisation.

post.summary: Exchange a GitHub OAuth authorization code for an access token (web sign-in). GitHub's response body is returned verbatim.

400.description: Missing code, or GitHub rejected it (`error` carries GitHub's OAuth error code)

502.description: GitHub unreachable or returned an unusable response

post.summary: Validate, then create the branch, commit and pull request on the registry with the caller's own token so the PR is authored by them. Global targets get the default reviewers; org targets use `reviewers`.

400.description: Payload failed schema or rule validation (`validation_failed`, `schema_invalid`, `invalid_reviewer`, `reviewers_not_allowed`)

403.description: Not an active EmergentSoftware member, or membership unverifiable (`not_org_member`, `org_membership_unverifiable`)

githubToken.description: A GitHub token (OAuth, `gh auth token`, or PAT) with `read:org`, and `repo` for publishing.

path.description: JSON pointer into the payload, when applicable
Path relative to the version directory

CheckoutResponse.description: A working copy of one asset version

files.description: Every file including manifest.json and README.md

FileEntry.description: A file in a version directory

path.description: Path relative to the version directory

code.description: Authorization code from the GitHub redirect

scheme.description: Auth scheme that validated the token (`github`)

path.description: Path relative to the version directory (no dotfiles, no `..`)

content.description: File content, text or base64 per `encoding`

isUpdate.description: True when the registry already has this asset or bundle

previousVersion.description: The registry's current latest when isUpdate

registryPath.description: Directory in the registry, with trailing slash

files.description: Files that will be committed, in order

warnings.description: Non-blocking advice (missing README, tags, unlisted files)

manifest.description: The exact `manifest.json` (kind=asset) or `bundle.json` (kind=bundle) to commit. Validated against the registry's JSON Schema; `files` must be a concrete array.

files.description: All other files: entrypoint, listed files, README.md. Bundles may only add README.md.

message.description: Optional notes appended to the PR body

reviewers.description: Reviewers to request. Only allowed for org-scoped targets; global targets always get the default reviewers.

replaceExistingBranch.description: Delete and recreate the publish branch if it already exists (the CLI's retry behaviour). Default false → 409 `branch_exists`.

client.description: Which client is publishing; only affects the PR footer

reviewerWarning.description: Set when the reviewer request failed; the PR still exists
